name: Active Directory (LDAP)
description: Sign in with a Windows / Active Directory user id and password. Passwords are checked by the directory and never stored.
author: ai-bi core

baseDn.title: Base DN
baseDn.description: Where users are searched, e.g. DC=corp,DC=example,DC=com

bindDn.title: Service account
bindDn.description: Account used to look users up, as DN or UPN (svc-aibi@corp.example.com). Leave empty to bind directly as the signing-in user.

upnSuffix.title: UPN suffix
upnSuffix.description: Appended to the user id when binding directly, e.g. corp.example.com

userFilter.title: Extra filter
userFilter.description: Optional LDAP filter every user must match, e.g. (memberOf=CN=BI Users,OU=Groups,DC=corp,DC=example,DC=com)

autoCreateUsers.title: Create an account on first sign-in
autoCreateUsers.description: Off: only user ids an admin added as project members can sign in
